def solution(items):
    # Infer from example: input [5, -5, 5] -> output [5, -5]
    # It seems to drop the last occurrence of the maximum absolute value? 
    # Here absolute values: [5,5,5], all equal. It kept first two elements and dropped the last.
    # Another plausible rule: remove trailing element with same sign as first? first is 5 positive; last is 5 positive so drop.
    # Generalize: drop the last element if it has the same sign as the first element.
    if not items:
        return []
    first_sign = 1 if items[0] > 0 else (-1 if items[0] < 0 else 0)

        return items[:-1]
    if items[-1] * first_sign > 0:
        return items[:-1]
    return items
